nodes.description: Private _transfer: enforces bot blacklist, triggers swap-and-liquify ETH conversion, then routes to _tokenTransfer.
Private swapTokensForEth: approves router and swaps contract tokens for ETH via UniswapV2 router; guarded by lockTheSwap.
Private sendETHToFee: forwards contract ETH balance to the fee wallet via transfer.
onlyOwner openTrading: sets router, creates pair, adds liquidity, enables swaps and cooldown.
manualswap: fee wallet gated manual token-to-ETH swap of the whole contract balance.
manualsend: fee wallet gated manual ETH forwarding to the fee wallet.
Private _transferStandard: computes reflection amounts, debits sender, credits recipient, takes team fee and reflects fee.
Private _takeTeam: mints reflection share of the team/tax portion to the contract.
Private _reflectFee: reduces _rTotal and increases _tFeeTotal.
Public balanceOf: converts reflection balance to token amount.
ERC20 transfer: forwards msg.sender, recipient and amount to _transfer.
ERC20 transferFrom: transfers on behalf of sender and decrements allowance.
Private _approve: writes allowance mapping and emits Approval.
onlyOwner blacklistBot: marks an address as bot.
onlyOwner removeFromBlacklist: clears bot flag for an address.
onlyOwner liftMaxTx: resets _maxTxAmount to _tTotal.
onlyOwner setCooldownEnabled: toggles cooldownEnabled.
Private tokenFromReflection: divides reflection amount by current rate.
Private _getRate: rSupply / tSupply.
Private _getCurrentSupply: returns current reflection and token supply.
receive(): accepts plain ETH transfers into the contract.
Private _tokenTransfer: dispatches the standard reflection transfer path.
ERC20 approve: sets allowance from msg.sender.
onlyOwner renounceOwnership: sets owner to zero address.
Public owner(): returns the stored _owner address.
mapping(address=>uint256) _rOwned: reflection balances.
mapping(address=>uint256) _tOwned: token balances.
mapping(address=>mapping(address=>uint256)) _allowances: ERC20 allowances.
mapping(address=>bool) _isExcludedFromFee.
mapping(address=>bool) bots: blacklist flags consulted by _transfer.
mapping(address=>uint) cooldown.
uint256 _rTotal: total reflections.
uint256 _tFeeTotal: accumulated fees.
uint256 _redis: redistribution percentage.
uint256 _tax: tax percentage.
uint256 _feeAddr1: first fee rate used by _getValues.
uint256 _feeAddr2: second fee rate used by _getValues.
address payable _feeAddrWallet1: ETH fee recipient and privileged caller.
IUniswapV2Router02 uniswapV2Router: router used for swaps and liquidity.
address uniswapV2Pair: liquidity pair address.
bool tradingOpen: trading activation flag.
bool inSwap: reentrancy guard used by lockTheSwap.
bool swapEnabled: enables automatic swap on transfer.
bool cooldownEnabled: cooldown toggle.
uint256 _maxTxAmount: maximum transfer amount.
msg.sender: caller-controlled address used for transfers, approvals and privileged checks.
block.timestamp: miner-influenced value passed as Uniswap deadline.
External call uniswapV2Router.swapExactTokensForETHSupportingFeeOnTransferTokens with attacker-influenceable path flow.
External ETH transfer _feeAddrWallet1.transfer(amount).
External calls to router factory/createPair/addLiquidityETH paying ETH from the contract.
Reflection arithmetic on _rOwned debits/credits (sub/add of rAmount and rTransferAmount).
Fee accounting arithmetic _rTotal.sub(rFee) and _tFeeTotal.add(tFee).
address from parameter of _transfer.
address to parameter of _transfer.
uint256 amount parameter of _transfer.
Local contractTokenBalance inside _transfer.
Local contractETHBalance inside _transfer.
uint256 tokenAmount parameter of swapTokensForEth.
uint256 tAmount parameter of _transferStandard.
Local rAmount computed in _transferStandard.
Local rFee computed in _transferStandard.
address _address parameter of blacklistBot.
address account parameter of balanceOf.

edges.reason: msg.sender is used as the ERC20 transfer origin.
msg.sender becomes the owner in public approve.
msg.sender is the spender in transferFrom.
manualswap authorizes the caller against _feeAddrWallet1.
manualsend authorizes the caller against _feeAddrWallet1.
block.timestamp is passed as the Uniswap deadline, making the swap timestamp dependent.
block.timestamp is passed as the addLiquidityETH deadline.
transfer forwards sender, recipient and amount into _transfer.
transferFrom forwards sender, recipient and amount into _transfer.
_transfer writes _feeAddr1 from _redis before computing values.
_transfer writes _feeAddr2 from _tax and zeroes it for the owner.
uniswapV2Pair is compared against from to gate the auto-swap.
_rOwned balances are debited and credited in _transferStandard.
_rTotal is reduced by the reflection fee.
_tFeeTotal accumulates the token fee.
Fee ETH is sent to the privileged _feeAddrWallet1 address.
uniswapV2Router is the target of the swap call.
inSwap guard is set by lockTheSwap around swapTokensForEth.
_transfer triggers swapTokensForEth which performs an external router call before state settlement completes.
_transfer calls sendETHToFee, causing an external ETH transfer.
_transfer queries balanceOf(address(this)) to size the swap.
_transfer delegates the accounting to _tokenTransfer.
_tokenTransfer calls _transferStandard.
_transferStandard calls _takeTeam.
_transferStandard calls _reflectFee.
_transferStandard executes reflection balance arithmetic.
_reflectFee executes fee accounting arithmetic.
manualswap invokes the external-swap routine directly.
manualsend invokes the external ETH transfer routine.
openTrading approves the router through _approve.
openTrading creates the pair and adds liquidity via external router calls.
openTrading stores the router address.
openTrading stores the created pair address.
setCooldownEnabled mutates cooldownEnabled under onlyOwner.
liftMaxTx mutates _maxTxAmount under onlyOwner.
blacklistBot writes the bots mapping under onlyOwner.
removeFromBlacklist clears the bots mapping under onlyOwner.
_transfer checks bots[from] to block blacklisted senders.
sendETHToFee executes an external ETH transfer to the fee wallet.
swapTokensForEth performs the external Uniswap swap call.
The external router swap can re-enter the token transfer path (token callbacks/hooks) while inSwap protection is partial.
The external ETH transfer to the fee wallet can re-enter the contract through receive().
Router liquidity/pair creation calls can call back into the token contract.
The from parameter determines the sender branch and owner-fee override.
The to parameter is the credit target of the transfer.
The amount parameter is validated and split into fees.
contractTokenBalance local drives the auto-swap amount.
contractETHBalance local drives the fee payout threshold.
tokenAmount parameter is the swap input amount.
tAmount parameter feeds _getValues in _transferStandard.
rAmount local is subtracted from the sender reflection balance.
rFee local is passed to _reflectFee.
blacklist target address parameter is written into the bots mapping.
account parameter indexes _rOwned inside balanceOf.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter from only carries the caller-supplied address into _transfer.
Parameter to only carries the recipient address into _transfer.
Parameter amount only carries the transfer value into _transfer.
Local contractTokenBalance is computed and consumed inside _transfer.
Local contractETHBalance is computed and consumed inside _transfer.
Parameter tokenAmount is only used as the swap input inside swapTokensForEth.
Parameter tAmount is only used inside _transferStandard.
Local rAmount is derived and consumed in _transferStandard.
Local rFee is derived and consumed in _transferStandard and _reflectFee.
Parameter _address is only written into the bots mapping by blacklistBot.
Parameter account is only used to index _rOwned in balanceOf.
